cards.p: Someone asked about training with me. Reply: what a first session looks like, price [price], two open times.
Write 6 questions for a new client: goals, schedule, past training, injuries to clear with a doctor, budget.
A lead asked my prices [days] days ago and went quiet. Write one friendly check in, no pressure.
Explain my [1 to 1, small group, online] options for a beginner in plain words. Who each fits: [paste].
[Name] missed 2 sessions this month. Write a kind check in text that asks what got in the way.
Write a welcome text for [name]: where to find me, what to wear, what to bring, parking [info].
Turn my notes on [name]'s month into a short, upbeat text: [paste]. Focus on effort and wins, not looks.
[Name] feels stuck and wants to quit. Write a warm reply that reminds them of their wins: [list].
Turn my messy notes into a clean card for [name]: exercises, sets, reps, what to change next time: [paste].
Plan my week from these client times: [paste]. Group by gym, add travel time and one lunch break.
My gym is closed [date]. Write a text moving clients to [new time] or an outdoor session at [place].
Write a short text for [name] with the home routine we agreed: [paste]. Easy to follow on a phone.
[Name] just hit [goal]. Write a text that celebrates it and asks for a Google review [link]. Short.
Reply to this 5 star review in my voice: [paste]. Thank them, mention their goal, under 30 words.
Reply to this unhappy review: [paste]. Calm, no excuses, say what I will change, invite them to call.
Write 3 questions to ask happy clients for a short, honest quote I can share with their okay.
Plan 7 posts for this week from one photo of my gym: [describe]. Mix tips, stories and questions.
Write a post for people scared of the gym: what a first session with me is like. Warm, 80 words.
Write a client spotlight from these notes, shared with their okay: [paste]. Focus on effort, not looks.
Write 10 short reel hooks about [topic] for busy parents who want to start training.
[Name]'s package payment of [amount] is [days] days late. Write a polite reminder with my pay link [link].
Write my 24 hour cancel policy in plain words: late cancel fee [fee], one free pass every [period].
Sort these receipts into gear, gym fees, courses, travel, other: [paste]. Total each, flag any missing a date.
Turn my prices [paste] into 3 packages of 4, 8 and 12 sessions. What each includes, price per session.
